_comment: The factory's label set. Edit here, then run `uv run python -m factory.sync_labels --apply` from main. `renames` is old name to new name. Sync renames with `gh label edit <old> --name <new>` and never deletes. Meanings: docs/agents/triage-labels.md and docs/factory/README.md.

labels.name: needs-triage
labels.description: Maintainer needs to evaluate this issue

labels.name: needs-info
labels.description: Waiting on reporter for more information

labels.name: ready-for-agent
labels.description: Fully specified; an agent can build it, on the laptop or by the factory

labels.name: ready-for-human
labels.description: Issue only: requires human implementation

labels.name: wontfix
labels.description: This will not be worked on

labels.name: owner:implement
labels.description: Owner-applied: approves a Spec's Tickets, or one hand-written Ticket

labels.name: owner:research
labels.description: Owner-applied: the factory answers this research request

labels.name: owner:check
labels.description: Owner-applied: the factory answers with a short live check

labels.name: owner:retro
labels.description: Owner-applied: a Retro of proposals for new checks and standards

labels.name: scout:ready
labels.description: Scout-applied: a Goal ready for the Builder (does not start the factory)

labels.name: builder:claimed
labels.description: Builder-applied: the Builder has claimed this Goal issue and is planning it

labels.name: builder:spec-ready
labels.description: Builder-applied: the Spec is ready for the owner (does not start the factory)

labels.name: factory:start
labels.description: Factory-applied: the App starts this Ticket; claim removes it

labels.name: factory:in-progress
labels.description: Factory-applied: the one-at-a-time lock while this Ticket is in progress

labels.name: factory:rework
labels.description: Factory-applied, or the owner by hand: starts one rework round

labels.name: factory:rework-1
labels.description: Factory-applied: this pull request was blocked once

labels.name: factory:rework-2
labels.description: Factory-applied: blocked twice; the next blocker stops the factory

labels.name: factory:stopped
labels.description: Factory-applied: two rework rounds were not enough, so the factory stopped

labels.name: factory:failed
labels.description: Factory-applied: the last Implement or Rework run failed

labels.name: factory:override
labels.description: Factory-applied: records an Override comment on this pull request

labels.name: factory:standards
labels.description: Factory-applied: the rolling issue of non-blocking Standards Findings

labels.name: factory:signals
labels.description: Factory-applied: the one open issue where the factory records its failures and retries
